content_sections.heading: PRL Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the PRL Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download PRL Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: PRL Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 9 vacancies are available - 2 for Library Trainee, 1 for Turner, 2 for Machinist, 1 for Plumber, 1 for Carpenter and 2 for Electrician.

content_sections.heading: PRL Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Library Trainee: Post Graduate Degree in Library & Information Science (60% marks or above). Preference to regular mode degree. Turner: ITI (First Class in Related Trade). 1-2 years experience desirable. Machinist: ITI (First Class in Related Trade). 1-2 years experience desirable. Plumber: ITI (First Class in Related Trade). 1-2 years experience desirable. Carpenter: ITI (First Class in Related Trade). 1-2 years experience desirable. Electrician: ITI (First Class in Related Trade). 1-2 years experience desirable.

content_sections.heading: PRL Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 18 years Maximum Age: 28 years Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India rules. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: PRL Recruitment 2026 - Salary

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for PRL Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for PRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the PRL Recruitment 2026 is scheduled for 07 October 2026. Candidates should ensure they report to the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the PRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies announced for various posts including Library Trainee, Turner, Machinist, Plumber, Carpenter, and Electrician in the Physical Research Laboratory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Library Trainee post?
faq.answer: For the Library Trainee position, candidates need a Post Graduate Degree in Library & Information Science with 60% marks or above. Preference will be given to those with a regular mode degree.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for all posts is between 18 years and 28 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the rules of the Government of India.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Turner, Machinist, Plumber, Carpenter, and Electrician posts?
faq.answer: The salary for Turner, Machinist, Plumber, Carpenter, and Electrician posts is ₹17,500/- per month. The Library Trainee post offers a higher salary of ₹29,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for PRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Skill Test followed by Document Verification. Candidates need to perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Physical Research Laboratory located?
faq.answer: The Physical Research Laboratory is located in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, with the pincode 380009. Candidates should report to the specified venue in Ahmedabad.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply online for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, this recruitment is being conducted through a Walk-in Interview. There is no online application process. Candidates must report directly to the venue on the specified date.
